name: Mephaath
overview: Mephaath is identified in Scripture as a Levitical city within the territory of the tribe of Reuben, consistently mentioned alongside Kedemoth and Jahazah. The passages in Joshua and 1 Chronicles emphasize its designation as a city with suburbs, highlighting its role in the Levitical allotment. Additionally, Jeremiah 48:21 references Mephaath in the context of divine judgment upon the plain country, indicating its inclusion in prophetic declarations concerning the region.
